source: I want to create an open world role playing experience for fans of Lord of The Rings. It will be a cozy game where players can tend to their gardens, trade vegetables, and explore the idyllic nature around with their friends. I want the game to be set up in the Shire. For my first map, I want to create Hobbiton, where players will have their own hobbit burrows. Can you create a realistic replica of Hobbiton?

answers.ask: How many burrows should Hobbiton hold? That sets whether this is a 500-stud village or a 2000-stud valley.
answers.answer: Build a compact 500-stud Hobbiton village with around 12 player burrows; keep it cozy and easy to explore with friends.

answers.ask: Do players claim an existing burrow, or dig and customise their own?
answers.answer: Players should claim one of the existing hobbit burrows, with simple customization of their garden and interior rather than digging new burrows.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: How many burrows should Hobbiton hold? That sets whether this is a 500-stud village or a 2000-stud valley. A: Build a compact 500-stud Hobbiton village with around 12 player burrows; keep it cozy and easy to explore with friends.
- [author] shape — Q: Do players claim an existing burrow, or dig and customise their own? A: Players should claim one of the existing hobbit burrows, with simple customization of their garden and interior rather than digging new burrows.
- [agent_inferred] adaptation — Q: How should the named copyrighted setting be represented safely? A: Build an original realistic pastoral fantasy hill village with round-doored earth-sheltered burrows, retaining the cozy rural spatial register without reproducing a protected map.

## Enriched image prompt
Create an original realistic pastoral fantasy village across a compact 500-stud area of rolling green hills. Arrange around 12 pre-built, claimable, round-doored burrow homes partially set into the hills, each with its own small customizable garden plot and enterable interior. Connect all homes with gentle pedestrian paths leading to one cozy central produce-trading green. Surround the village with idyllic natural planting and keep the slopes, paths, burrow entrances, gardens, and shared green easy to explore with friends. Do not reproduce a copyrighted map or identifiable landmark arrangement.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim, with Simulation secondary for the repeatable gardening and vegetable-trading activity.

## Shape and preset
Use `settlement-claimable`: around 12 finished burrow homes are claimed and lightly customized rather than constructed. Use the Life preset for its claimable-home model and enterable homes, while dropping vehicle roads and urban district zoning that contradict the compact walking village.

## Config requirements
Use `building-interior` for around 12 enterable burrow interiors. Use `path-street` for gentle pedestrian paths linking every burrow to the central green. Use `social-hub` for the cozy produce-trading green. Use `terrain-relief` for the rolling hills containing the earth-sheltered homes. Use the visible half of `trigger-task` as around 12 small garden plots, one beside each burrow.

## Layout requirements
Place around 12 `trigger-task` gardening stations, one in each burrow's garden plot. Place around 12 scene-specific Plot claim markers with no canonical option ID, one at each burrow entrance, and one scene-specific TriggerZone produce-exchange interaction at the central green. Keep every claim and garden paired to a distinct pre-built home.

## Layout components
The build is a 500-stud village containing around 12 burrows, around 12 gardens, around 12 interiors, one central trading green, and a connected pedestrian path network over rolling hills. Natural planting defines the soft outer boundary. Compose the village so the shared green anchors the frame and every burrow remains connected without a vehicle grid.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: the relationship between hill relief, earth-sheltered homes, gardens, paths, and central green is primarily visual rather than topology-critical.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium, fixed at roughly 500 studs with around 12 homes. The theme is realistic cozy pastoral fantasy with original round-doored hill burrows. Use `P3` because players move between outdoor village paths and burrow interiors, plus `tiered` for rolling hill relief without overhangs.
